description: Static clipboard holding copied/cut cells for internal copy-paste operations.

members.name: Copy
members.description: Stores the given cells into the clipboard.

members.name: Cut
members.description: Stores the given cells into the clipboard and marks it as a cut operation.

members.name: Cells
members.description: The copied/cut cells keyed by their relative position within the source range.

members.name: IsCut
members.description: Whether the clipboard content came from a cut operation.

members.name: SourceRangeRef
members.description: The source range reference (e.g. A1:B2) used for the copy/cut.
